raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #43162.

`dtype` is a `choices`-validated server argument whose help text lists `"float32"` (and its alias `"float"`) as supported values. The argument was accepted without complaint, but starting the engine aborted the whole process group with an unhandled `KeyError: torch.float32` raised deep inside FlashInfer's decode wrapper during CUDA-graph capture. FlashInfer has no FP32 attention kernels (`torch.float32` is missing from its `filename_safe_dtype_map`), so any FP32 model on the flashinfer backend was doomed from the start, and sglang surfaced it as a mid-startup crash instead of a configuration error.

## Modifications

**`python/sglang/srt/arg_groups/attention_hook.py`**
- In `handle_attention_backend_compatibility`, right after the default attention backend is filled, raise a clear, actionable `ValueError` when `dtype` is `"float"`/`"float32"` and the resolved prefill or decode backend is `flashinfer`. The error names the unsupported combination and points at `--dtype bfloat16/float16` or an FP32-capable backend (`torch_native`, `triton`). Split prefill/decode backends are checked too, since the original crash happened in the decode path.

**`test/registered/unit/server_args/test_server_args.py`**
- Add `TestFlashInferFp32DtypeGuard` with 6 cases: explicit `flashinfer` + `float32` raises, the `"float"` alias raises, split `prefill=triton`/`decode=flashinfer` raises, and the allowed combinations (`bfloat16`+`flashinfer`, `float32`+`triton`, `float32`+`torch_native`) do not raise.

## Tests

- New unit tests follow the existing `TestFa4PageSizeAutoForce` pattern in the same file (construct `ServerArgs(model_path="dummy")`, mock `_model_config`, call `handle_attention_backend_compatibility` directly).
- Verified the guard logic against the real handler with a stub harness covering 8 scenarios (explicit backend, auto-selected backend, split backends, allowed combos): all pass.
- Could not run the full GPU e2e repro here (no CUDA on this machine); the pre-existing CPU unit suite path (`test/registered/unit/server_args`) is the appropriate gate for this change.

detail.title: Fail fast when dtype=float32 is used with the flashinfer attention backend

files.patch:
@@ -52,6 +52,24 @@ def handle_attention_backend_compatibility(server_args: Any):
     # Split-backend override + default fill.
     run_post_process_pass(server_args, _attention_backend_default)
 
+    # FlashInfer has no FP32 attention kernels: torch.float32 is missing from
+    # flashinfer's filename_safe_dtype_map, so a model running in FP32 crashes
+    # mid-startup during CUDA-graph capture with a bare `KeyError:
+    # torch.float32` that kills the whole engine process group. Fail fast with
+    # an actionable message instead of letting that KeyError escape.
+    if resolving_view(server_args).dtype in ("float", "float32"):
+        prefill_backend, decode_backend = attention_backends_of(
+            resolved_view(server_args)
+        )
+        if "flashinfer" in (prefill_backend, decode_backend):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "attention backend 'flashinfer' does not support dtype='float32': "
+                "FlashInfer has no FP32 attention kernels, so the engine would "
+                "crash during CUDA-graph capture with `KeyError: torch.float32`. "
+                "Use --dtype bfloat16 or float16, or select an FP32-capable "
+                "backend such as --attention-backend torch_native or triton."
+            )
+
     # Torch native and flex attention backends
     attention_backend = resolved_view(server_args).attention_backend
     if attention_backend == "torch_native":

@@ -1464,6 +1464,54 @@ def test_explicit_prefill_fa4_forces_page_size_128(self):
         self.assertEqual(resolved_view(args).page_size, 128)
 
 
+class TestFlashInferFp32DtypeGuard(CustomTestCase):
+    """FlashInfer has no FP32 attention kernels, so dtype=float32 with the
+    flashinfer backend crashed mid-startup during CUDA-graph capture with a
+    bare `KeyError: torch.float32` that killed the engine process group
+    (sgl-project/sglang#43162). Resolution must fail fast with an actionable
+    error instead."""
+
+    def _make_args(self, dtype, attention_backend=None, prefill=None, decode=None):
+        args = ServerArgs(model_path="dummy", dtype=dtype)
+        args.attention_backend = attention_backend
+        args.prefill_attention_backend = prefill
+        args.decode_attention_backend = decode
+        # Short-circuit model_config_of(): the guard only needs the resolved
+        # dtype/backend fields, not a real ModelConfig.
+        args._model_config = MagicMock()
+        return args
+
+    def test_flashinfer_with_float32_raises(self):
+        args = self._make_args(dtype="float32", attention_backend="flashinfer")
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "float32"):
+            handle_attention_backend_compatibility(args)
+
+    def test_flashinfer_with_float_alias_raises(self):
+        # "float" is the documented FP32 alias; it must be guarded too.
+        args = self._make_args(dtype="float", attention_backend="flashinfer")
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "float32"):
+            handle_attention_backend_compatibility(args)
+
+    def test_flashinfer_split_decode_backend_raises(self):
+        # The crash in #43162 happened in the decode path (FlashInfer decode
+        # wrapper JIT), so a split backend with flashinfer decode must raise.
+        args = self._make_args(dtype="float32", prefill="triton", decode="flashinfer")
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "flashinfer"):
+            handle_attention_backend_compatibility(args)
+
+    def test_flashinfer_with_bfloat16_is_allowed(self):
+        args = self._make_args(dtype="bfloat16", attention_backend="flashinfer")
+        handle_attention_backend_compatibility(args)  # must not raise
+
+    def test_fp32_with_triton_is_allowed(self):
+        args = self._make_args(dtype="float32", attention_backend="triton")
+        handle_attention_backend_compatibility(args)  # must not raise
+
+    def test_fp32_with_torch_native_is_allowed(self):
+        args = self._make_args(dtype="float32", attention_backend="torch_native")
+        handle_attention_backend_compatibility(args)  # must not raise
+
+
 class TestContextParallelServerArgs(CustomTestCase):
